source:
[u][b]The Popular Oppai Spy Bartender![/b][/u]
Race: Dark Elf
Code Name: Shaker
Libido and Lewdness Level: 3.8 / 5.0
Masturbation Frequency: Normal

One of the faculty at the spy academy, and a dark elf. Her codename is “Shaker,” a name given to her during her active years because she specialized in “shaking people up.” She has a transistor-glamour figure, and despite her small stature, her boobs are massive T-cups.

She is the master and bartender of the academy cafeteria, the “Spy Bar.” The reason the cafeteria takes the form of a bar is because spies often gather information in bars, so the academy wants students to become accustomed to that kind of atmosphere from their school days. Even so, since it is still a place of learning for students, alcohol itself is not served. Instead, the academy specialty known as “Gray Beer” is actually non-alcoholic beer, and thanks to its delicious taste it has become extremely popular among the students. Also, though only the staff know this, the Spy Bar apparently has a “nighttime face” as well?

Since the name “TinTin” is impossible not to tease, she has been made fun of over it ever since her student days. TinTin, after all. Because of that, she makes the students call her “Tee-chan,” and anyone who calls her by her real name is punished. Combined with her personality and short height, she is adored by the students as something of the bar’s mascot.

Although her way of speaking is blunt, she is friendly and extremely caring, making her beloved by everyone. She is also highly capable, possessing the skill to manage the constantly crowded Spy Bar, along with broad awareness and sharp intuition. During her student years she served as the prefect of Night Owl, and was rivals with Olivia, who at the time was the prefect of Wolfard.

She was the first to notice the mission assigned to the protagonist, and offered to help him since he was unfamiliar with the academy. From then on, she provides him with valuable information regarding the academy and its students as one of his assets. She has essentially become the protagonist’s partner, and she herself does not seem entirely unhappy about that.

Her hobbies are creating original cocktails, food tourism, and watching romance dramas. The things she dislikes are people who pat her on the head, and people who call her by her real name.
